description.value: Greek House Restaurant has anchored the Okanagan Valley dining scene since 1993, transporting guests past life-size statuary of Athena, Poseidon, Diana, and Apollo into a room filled with Greek art, music, and a trickling fountain. Owner and executive chef Christos Vassilopoulos prepares authentic dishes — souvlaki, spanakopita, keftethes, and roast lamb — entirely from scratch using fresh ingredients. The restaurant is popular enough that its branded products now appear in regional supermarkets and specialty stores, making it a genuine culinary landmark for touring cyclists passing through Lake Country.

address.value: 3159 Woodsdale Road, Lake Country, BC V4V 1X8
